nodes.description: Constant address of the Curve stETH pool used as deposit target.
Constant address of the steCRV LP token received from the Curve pool.
Constant address of the stETH token pulled and approved to the pool.
Inherited DFSRegistry constant used to look up action contracts.
Inherited DefisaverLogger constant used to emit direct action events.
Public payable entry point that parses mapped inputs and performs the curve stETH deposit, returning received LP as bytes32.
Public payable single-action entry point that decodes calldata and performs the deposit, logging via logger.
Pure function declaring the action as STANDARD_ACTION.
Internal core logic that pulls/withdraws WETH, pulls and approves stETH, calls the Curve pool and forwards LP tokens.
Internal pure helper that abi.decodes the raw calldata into a Params struct.
Inherited helper that substitutes address inputs with subscription or return values.
Inherited helper that substitutes uint inputs with subscription or return values.
TokenUtils helper that transfers tokens from a user-specified account into the proxy.
TokenUtils helper that sends tokens (or ETH via low-level call) from the proxy to a target address.
TokenUtils helper that approves a spender if the current allowance is insufficient.
TokenUtils helper that unwraps WETH into native ETH before depositing to the Curve pool.
External caller of executeAction/executeActionDirect and of the underlying token callbacks.
Time-dependent value used by the registry/admin auth logic that gates action execution.
External payable call to ICurveStethPool.add_liquidity sending ETH value and user-controlled amounts.
Low-level recipient.call{value: amount} inside withdrawTokens, sending ETH to a user-controlled address.
safeTransfer of LP/ERC20 tokens to a user-controlled recipient address.
safeTransferFrom pulling tokens from a user-controlled address into the proxy.
safeApprove granting allowance over stETH to the Curve pool.
Raw encoded calldata passed into executeAction/executeActionDirect.
Subscription values that replace input parameters.
Mapping array describing which inputs should be substituted.
Return values from previous actions injectable into inputs.
Decoded Params struct holding from, to, amounts and minMintAmount.
Params struct passed into _curveDeposit.
Amount of LP tokens returned by the Curve pool deposit.
ABI-encoded deposit result emitted through the logger/action event.
User-supplied address from which tokens are pulled.
User-supplied amount of tokens pulled, approved or withdrawn.
User-supplied recipient of withdrawn tokens or ETH.
Token address used in pull/withdraw/approve helpers.

edges.reason: Raw calldata is abi.decoded into the Params struct by parseInputs.
Parsed Params struct is forwarded into the deposit logic.
executeAction invokes _curveDeposit after parsing inputs.
executeActionDirect invokes _curveDeposit directly.
params.from and params.to are substituted through _parseParamAddr.
params.amounts and minMintAmount are substituted through _parseParamUint.
_subData values can overwrite the parsed address inputs.
_paramMapping dictates whether address inputs are replaced.
_paramMapping dictates whether uint inputs are replaced.
_returnValues can be injected into uint inputs.
Deposit logic pulls WETH or stETH from the user before interacting with the pool.
WETH is unwrapped to ETH before depositing into the Curve pool.
stETH allowance to the Curve pool is set before the deposit call.
External payable call to the Curve pool occurs before LP tokens are transferred out.
Received LP tokens are transferred to a user-controlled recipient after the external pool call.
pullTokensIfNeeded performs an external token transferFrom on a user-supplied token.
approveToken performs an external safeApprove on the token.
withdrawTokens sends ETH to a user-controlled address via low-level call.
withdrawTokens performs an ERC20 safeTransfer to the recipient.
msg.sender controls entry into executeAction and the user-supplied params.
msg.sender controls entry into executeActionDirect.
Caller-driven params decide the ETH recipient of the low-level call.
Time-dependent registry state gates which action contract address is used.
_from is the account tokens are pulled from.
_amount is the quantity pulled from the user.
_to is the recipient of withdrawn tokens or ETH.
_token selects the asset being transferred out.
params.to becomes the LP token withdrawal recipient.
params.amounts feed the amounts used for pulls and deposits.
_params carries all user-controlled deposit parameters into the logic.
The Curve pool call returns the received LP amount.
receivedLp is encoded into logData for the event.
logData is emitted through the DefisaverLogger.
CURVE_STETH_POOL_ADDR is the target of the external add_liquidity call.
STE_CRV_ADDR is the LP token forwarded to the recipient.
STETH_ADDR is the token approved to the Curve pool.
STETH_ADDR is the token pulled from the user.

normalization_plan.reason: _callData is only decoded by parseInputs, so it collapses into that core helper.
_subData is consumed only by address parameter substitution in _parseParamAddr.
_paramMapping drives address substitution and is fully absorbed by _parseParamAddr.
_returnValues are injected into uint parameters inside _parseParamUint.
The decoded Params struct is the input to the core _curveDeposit logic.
_params is the memory argument processed by _curveDeposit.
receivedLp is the direct return value of the external Curve pool add_liquidity call.
logData is produced inside _curveDeposit for the action event.
_from is used only as the source account in pullTokensIfNeeded.
_amount is used only as the transferred quantity in pullTokensIfNeeded.
_to is used only as the recipient in withdrawTokens.
_token is used only as the asset selector in withdrawTokens.
